bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'WINDOWS_INTEROP\n'
ps=/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe
test -f "$ps" || { printf 'WINDOWS_POWERSHELL_PATH_MISSING\n' >&2; exit 74; }
"$ps" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"; $r="F:\G-ACE-KB\repo"; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $r -PathType Container){Set-Location -LiteralPath $r; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short --branch; foreach($f in @("scripts/learning_asset_contract.py","tests/test_learning_asset_contract.py","docs/DESIGN_DELTA.md","docs/PROJECT_TREE.md","scripts/learning_asset_store.py","tests/test_learning_asset_store.py")){if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $f -PathType Leaf){"$f $((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"}else{"MISSING $f"}}; "DATA_LEARNING_EXISTS=$(Test-Path -LiteralPath F:\G-ACE-KB\data\learning)"; "PYTHON"; Get-Command python,py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders}else{"FORMAL_REPO_NOT_FOUND"}; "CURSOR"; Get-Command cursor,cursor-agent,agent,composer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders; $zip="C:\Users\Owner\Downloads\debugai_dataset_audited_v0_3.zip"; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $zip -PathType Leaf){"DATASET_BYTES=$((Get-Item -LiteralPath $zip).Length)";"DATASET_SHA=$((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"}'
